tool.name: Convert Parquet to tabular
tool.help:
What it does ------------ Converts Parquet files to tabular format.
All columns are converted to strings, with nested structures serialized as JSON.
Supported Data Types -------------------- The following Parquet data types are supported:
- **integer**: Converted to integer strings (e.g., "42") - **floating-point**: Converted to floating-point strings (e.g., "3.14") - **boolean**: Converted to "True" or "False" strings - **string**: Preserved as-is - **date, time, timestamp**: Converted to string representation - **list/array**: Serialized as JSON array (e.g., "[1,2,3]") - **struct/map/dict**: Serialized as JSON object (e.g., '{"key":"value"}') - **null**: Converted to empty string
Note: JSON arrays/objects are quoted in the output to protect internal tabs and commas.
